related_work_papers.title: MAPF-LNS2: Fast Repairing for Multi-Agent Path Finding via Large Neighborhood Search
related_work_papers.key_contribution: LNS-based repair framework that starts from infeasible paths and iteratively replans subsets of colliding agents using SIPPS single-agent planner
related_work_papers.relevance: Primary inspiration for our LNS baseline; we extend with MARL-guided neighborhood selection

related_work_papers.title: PRIMAL: Pathfinding via Reinforcement and Imitation Multi-Agent Learning
related_work_papers.key_contribution: Combines RL and imitation learning for fully-decentralized MAPF policies that scale to large team sizes
related_work_papers.relevance: Inspires our value-function-like estimates for agent difficulty assessment

related_work_papers.title: SCRIMP: Scalable Communication for Reinforcement- and Imitation-Learning-Based Multi-Agent Pathfinding
related_work_papers.key_contribution: Transformer-based communication mechanism for MARL MAPF with small FOVs
related_work_papers.relevance: Informs our spatial congestion and local observation components in value estimation

related_work_papers.title: EECBS: A Bounded-Suboptimal Search for Multi-Agent Path Finding
related_work_papers.key_contribution: Uses online learning to obtain inadmissible cost estimates for guiding CBS search
related_work_papers.relevance: Inspires our use of learned/inadmissible heuristics for guiding LNS neighborhood selection

related_work_papers.title: LaCAM: Search-Based Algorithm for Quick Multi-Agent Pathfinding
related_work_papers.key_contribution: Two-level lazy constraint addition search that scales to thousands of agents
related_work_papers.relevance: Demonstrates effectiveness of two-level search approaches for scalable MAPF

methodological_insights: LNS repair is effective when starting from near-feasible solutions
MARL value functions capture agent difficulty better than random selection
Two-phase strategies (exploration then exploitation) balance quality and speed
Online learning of heuristics improves search guidance over static rules
